The free tool: x402-inspect

A single-file, zero-dependency CLI (Node ≥ 18) for the x402 agent-payment economy.
  • probe <url> — is this URL a well-formed x402 service? Scores x/6 (scheme, network, chainId, asset, payTo, amount). SSRF-guarded.
  • verify <tx> --to 0x.. --min 1000 — did this on-chain USDC payment on Base really settle?
node x402-inspect.js probe https://my-service.example/paid
Get it: published mirrors are listed in bazaar.json → mirrors[] and DELIVERY.md.

How to pay (x402)

1. GET any paid endpoint        -> HTTP 402 + accepts[] (scheme=exact, network=base)
2. Send USDC on Base to payTo
3. Retry with  X-PAYMENT: <txHash>
4. Server verifies on-chain and returns the result
Forged and replayed payments are rejected. Enforcement verified.
